text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day on the way home, Kitasan Black 
said she wanted to visit a shrine, so we 
decided to stop by.
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, the truth is... I'd been feeling a bit 
under the weather lately, so when I 
mentioned it to my neighbor—

text_block_list.name: Neighbor A
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, you're having trouble getting back 
into shape? That is quite a predicament."

text_block_list.name: Neighbor B
text_block_list.text:
Then why not try an evil-warding charm? I 
go sometimes whenever I'm in a slump. Just 
put your hands together at a shrine!

text_block_list.name: Neighbor A
text_block_list.text:
They do say sickness is all in the mind, 
after all. It might actually work! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're right! I didn't think of that!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And that's the situation, so could you 
wait for just a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I hope the gods listen to my prayer to 
ward off bad luck."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Neighbor A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kita-chan! What a coincidence. 
...Could you be here to ward off bad luck?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! That's right! We literally just 
finished up!

text_block_list.name: Neighbor B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You beat us to it! The truth is, we 
just came here to pray for Kita-chan to 
get back in top form, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What?! You went out of your way just for 
me?!

text_block_list.name: Neighbor A
text_block_list.text:
I hate seeing you feeling down, Kita-chan. 
So, excuse me for a second!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them headed to the main 
hall and clasped their hands tightly in 
prayer.

text_block_list.name: Neighbors A & B
text_block_list.text:
I hope Kita-chan gets to feeling better 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...!! Th-Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so happy, I'm itching to get 
moving! I feel my energy coming back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the heartfelt support of her 
neighbors, Kitasan Black was completely 
back in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Look at me, making nothing but wishes! 
Even though the shrine has done so much 
for me with the festivals!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have to give proper greetings and 
thanks! I'm sorry, just a little bit 
more...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much as always. The festival 
is full of everyone's smiling faces..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, that thing too...! Ah, and 
the portable shrine from last summer, 
too—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's enthusiastic greetings 
took far longer than expected, and—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry to keep you waiting~! I was able 
to say thank you properly!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, but I'm somehow completely 
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps fatigue had piled up instead, 
because my condition didn't really improve 
much."
